description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PostInterestAsOnDateException' used within the 'savings' module of the Apache Fineract project. It includes an enum for specific error types related to posting interest dates and methods to retrieve associated error messages and codes.

classes.name: PostInterestAsOnDateException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors related to posting interest on specific dates within savings accounts. It encapsulates various error types defined in the nested enum.

classes.name: PostInterestAsOnDateException.PostInterestAsOnExceptionType
classes.description: Enumeration of specific error cases with methods to generate error messages and error codes based on the error type.

methods.name: PostInterestAsOnDateException.PostInterestAsOnExceptionType.errorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message corresponding to the specific error type.

methods.name: PostInterestAsOnDateException.PostInterestAsOnExceptionType.errorCode
methods.description: Returns an error code string for the specific error type.

methods.name: PostInterestAsOnDateException.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a specific error type which determines the message and code.
